headline: Claude Code 2.1.323 and Antigravity CLI 1.5.8 close more permission and sandbox gaps, on top of a week of new defaults.

themes.title: Permission and sandbox holes closed
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.319 closes a Bash permission bypass and a sandbox escape when creating a worktree ([2.1.319](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.319)), and 2.1.323 fixes a Bash `rm` check that skipped the dangerous-removal prompt ([2.1.323](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.323)). Antigravity CLI 1.5.8 closes a terminal sandbox proxy path bypass and makes Windows `cmd` and PowerShell allow rules exact ([1.5.8](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.8)).
themes.so_what: update Claude Code to 2.1.323 and Antigravity CLI to 1.5.8 or later.

themes.title: Headless runs get new exit codes, denials and defaults
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.319 makes `claude -p` exit 1 when auto mode refuses actions, where it used to exit 0 ([2.1.319](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.319)). Antigravity CLI 1.5.2 denies some `-p` requests that use `--dangerously-skip-permissions` ([1.5.2](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.2)), and 1.5.7 makes headless runs start in Auto when no mode is saved ([1.5.7](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.7)).
themes.so_what: scripts that trust exit 0 or the raw output should check these signals now, and any `agy -p` job without a saved mode now runs in Auto.

themes.title: New defaults change cost and behavior
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.321 makes `claude-fable-5-2` the new default Fable model, with 1M context at $8/$40 per Mtok ([2.1.321](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.321)). Codex 0.167.2 sends tool updates incrementally by default on Google Cloud Vertex AI ([rust-v0.167.2](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.167.2)), and Antigravity CLI 1.5.2 makes macOS Option-key shortcuts work by default ([1.5.2](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.2)).
themes.so_what: check the price of the Fable default before you rely on it, and re-check any pinned terminal or Vertex setting.

watch_next: Check that scheduled `claude -p` and `agy -p` jobs still pass with Claude Code 2.1.323 and Antigravity CLI 1.5.8, since 1.5.7 starts headless runs in Auto. Watch for the notes of Codex 0.168.0 and 0.169.0, and whether Kilo Code v7.8.28 becomes a stable release, since it is still marked pre-release.
